summary.intent: User wanted to clean up 84 repo-wide `TODO(phase 63/65)` comment markers left over from earlier CipherBox phases, using ultracode to classify each as already-resolved (stale) vs still describing a real unfinished limitation.

Added a new Phase 79 to ROADMAP.md to track the still-valid work and committed the planning update.

workflow: For repo-wide TODO/marker triage, enumerate markers first, sample comment text for context, then fan out one verifier agent per file via Workflow to classify each marker against current code — avoids one agent trying to hold all 84 markers across 21 files in context

When a classified 'resolved' marker is actually a describe.skip test stub, treat it separately from simple comment-deletions — reviving a test is a different, riskier action than deleting a stale comment, so segregate test files from the zero-risk cleanup pass
Use AskUserQuestion to let the user choose forks (e.g., delete-now vs schedule-later) after presenting a synthesized breakdown, rather than deciding unilaterally
